data: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
-28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime
Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage
Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet
Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup.
The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel.
The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.
Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel infront of Holliday.
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
+1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
Silences enemies for 2s if close range
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time.
While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path.
Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.
After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage.
The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
+1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.
Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.
While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.
Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.
Apollo Riposte melee resist reduction increased from -22% to -25% Riposte T2 changed from "-30% Melee Resist" to "-25% Melee Resist and +0.4s Stun…
